title: Claybourne - Single Episodes
segments: Dad, I can't get into this now. It's long distance.
But that means you were in New Zealand during the war.
You never told me.
I will, Dad.
Not for a while. I'm away on business.
Now you're not forgetting to eat, are you?
Well, just make sure you open them and eat what's inside.
I have to go now, Dad. Look after yourself.
Yeah. Take care.
Yeah, I'm fine.
So mad it was right.
Hey, going Karen.
The place is a mess.
Yeah, it's good to have you back.
What's up Frank? You look worried.
You remember they had to fell out of hell and used to get in to help at the station?
They'd learn.
They'd climb something or other.
Yeah, why do you need to know?
Well, I got a job from them. I've been trying to track them down.
Wish I could help you.
Yeah, me too.
Hang on. Do you still have that stuff of Hellens that gave you?
Yeah.
Was her a dress book in there?
Oh, I have it.
What?
Moody.
Clive Moody.
That's it.
Clive Bloody Moody.
Thanks, Karen.
What's the rush, Frank?
You win Lotto or something.
Oh, not now.
I'm busy.
Long reporting back, Frank.
Edith said it's okay to do the clearing.
Oh, yeah, yeah, right.
Great.
Anything else?
Yeah.
What about getting into the station?
Well, I'm working on it.
Thanks for your help, mother.
Have a beer on the house.
I appreciate everything you're doing.
Well, gee, thanks, Frank, any time.
Who's mad at talking to?
No one.
Of course. Well, you win, Mater. Good. Buy me a beer.
Sure.
Caron, two beers, please.
Good morning, Caron. Nice to see you. Don't you look nice. May I have two beers, please?
Sure, I'll just drop everything and serve you.
What's going on with you, too?
A little appreciation goes a long way.
Okay, thank you, Caron. I appreciate everything you're doing for me.
Put a sock on it.
And thank you, Mater.
What are you thanking me for?
I thought you felt a little underappreciated.
I am not by you. Now what did I win?
I just spoke to my father. He was here during the war.
So I guess I have to accept that I am the stranger in your prophecy.
Well, next round's on you too.
Well, until I find a way to disprove it.
Good luck.
So I don't get killed in this prophecy, do I?
Not everyone in it is doomed.
Helen was?
I.
What is anyone else supposed to die?
I.
Look for the passing of a great child of Tungor.
and note that its death will be a lonely one.
This will signal death of a great matriarchal figure.
So a child of Tuggeroa is going to die?
I don't know what it was the god of the sea.
A child of the god of the sea? Well, that could be a fish or anything.
A great child.
So a big fish? What about the matriarch? Who's that?
I'm not sure.
What can any of this be prevented?
If it could, then Helen would still be alive.
Claybourne was made with the help of your broadcasting fee, so you can hear more of New Zealand on
